about: Each mutant of tests/test_waivers_render.py::test_guard_fails_on_broken_builds (mirrored; tests/test_waivers_mutation_specificity.py compares them with the suite's source), the diagnostic its own check must report (regex, whole line after the [Npx] tag, at every width listed), the consequences of the same breakage that may also appear (each with a reason), and the verdict expected at audited main 430791c4. An entry with `values` also requires its `values` group to be in that order (a sort diagnostic's numbers). A designated or consequence pattern never accounts for a page error.

consequences.pattern: empty tab headline 'Values are still loading\.'
consequences.why: the empty-tab check reads the same <b>; with setText removed it keeps the shell's placeholder

designated.pattern: phone layout: table True cards True count \d+

consequences.why: the ten-column table shown at 390 px is wider than the screen

consequences.pattern: controls under 44 px on the Waivers tab \(\d+ checked\): \["button#\. '(?:Candidate|DDF Value|Value above waivers|Market value|Starter change|Bench change|Verdict)' \d+x32"(?:, "button#\. '(?:Candidate|DDF Value|Value above waivers|Market value|Starter change|Bench change|Verdict)' \d+x32")*\]
consequences.why: the table's sortable header buttons (no id or class, the 32 px min-height of `thead th button`) become visible at phone width; only those labels at that height may be listed, so a search-result button or another small control stays a harness failure

expect.why: The anchor removes only the statement after `if (S.sort.key === col.id)`, so that `if` now guards the `if (col.sort) {...}` block that creates the header buttons. Only the sorted column keeps its button, the DDF Value click waits 30 s and raises, and the suite counts the exception as a kill. The variant 'no aria-sort, whole statement' shows the designated check does catch missing aria-sort.

dashes sorted first.find: return nx ? 1 : -1;   // dashes last, whichever way

designated.pattern: the league-settings event did not redraw the tab
table role None labelled by v2WaiversHeadline
controls under 44 px on the Waivers tab \(\d+ checked\): \["button#\.v2-link v2-wv-remove 'Remove' \d+x20"(?:, "button#\.v2-link v2-wv-remove 'Remove' \d+x20")*\]

expect.why: check() appends the 'verdict cells' diagnostic and on the next line ranks the verdicts with order.index(v), which raises ValueError for an empty cell. run_checks never returns the list, and the suite counts the exception as a kill.
expect.no_variant: Any mutant that changes the verdict text to something outside the six verdict names hits the same order.index crash, so no production-source mutant can return the designated diagnostic until that line skips unknown verdicts.

consequences.why: the ascending check also compares aria-sort, which is still missing after the second click; the values themselves must still be ascending with dashes last

no aria-sort, whole statement.why: The fix proposed in JEG-1282: remove the whole `if (...) th.setAttribute(...)` statement, so the header buttons are still built.

browser unavailable.how: CHROMIUM_PATH points at a plain text file, so Chromium cannot launch; run once with RENDER_TESTS_REQUIRED=1 (RuntimeError) and once without (SkipTest).

navigation timeout.how: waivers.js polls the page every 100 ms, so page.goto never reaches networkidle and times out.

unrelated page error.how: waivers.js throws from a timer after the module has run.
unrelated page error.append: setTimeout(function () { throw new Error("JEG-1279 injected unrelated page error"); }, 0);

unrelated diagnostic.how: Two real mutants at once, judged as the first: the second one's diagnostic is unrelated to it.
